blurb: Geary Dance Center offers recreational dance classes for children ages 2-18, summer dance camps for ages 8 and up, and studio rentals. Classes are organized in semesters with trial classes available for children. The center hosts an annual student showcase and provides costume care guidance.
extraNote: No credit for studio rental cancellations without 24 hours notice · Studio rentals must occur during business hours or staff must be present for additional fee · Trial class fee forfeited if no-show · Summer camp cancellations after May 15th not reimbursed except for medical reasons; $100 cancellation fee applies for credit · Summer camp cancellations before May 15th get 50% refund minus $50 fee or full credit minus $50 fee · Office at 5036 Geary near 15th Ave for class check-in and trial classes.
